    Questions

    What does digital marketing include here?

    Everything: social media management, content creation, paid ads, SEO, email marketing, branding, website design, and analytics & reporting — plus design work like logos, flyers, birthday posts, and digital business cards.

    How much do marketing services cost?

    Marketing services — social media management, ads, SEO, email marketing, branding, content creation, and analytics — are quoted based on what your business needs. Call (570) 575-9202 or DM @luxeempirediginal for a free quote. Design prices are listed on this page.

    How do I pay?

    By OnePay or cash. Your exact price is confirmed before any work starts — no surprises after.

    How do I get my design or reports?

    Everything is digital, so there is no shipping. Finished designs and reports are sent straight to you, ready to post, share, or put online.

    What do you need from me to start?

    Your business name, what you sell, who your customers are, and any photos, words, or colors you want used. Call or DM and I will walk you through it.

    If you build my website, who owns the domain?

    You do. Your domain is registered in your name and your account, and it is handed over to you. Domain setup is $50; the registrar charges about $10–$20 for the first year and $15–$25 a year to renew, or $25 a year managed.

    Can you set up and run my social media account?

    Yes — account setup, posts, and full social media management. A single post is $15, the 5-post pack is $50, and ongoing management is quoted — DM or call for your quote.

    What does a birthday post include?

    A custom birthday design for $15 — the birthday name, your message, and the colors or photo style you pick, made ready to post.
